subject: src/Makefile: Link libatomic on POWER systems (#607)
reason: The change only edits src/Makefile to link libatomic when the build machine is a POWER (ppc*) system, fixing a link-time failure on that architecture. It alters no runtime behaviour, no command, reply, replication, persistence or cluster path; on the CI's Linux x86 host the added Makefile branch is not even taken, so both builds are byte-for-byte identical in behaviour and no fuzzer scenario can reach or distinguish the change. Build/link fixes are verified by the build itself succeeding, not by runtime scenarios.
